name: apto-rural
description: Pré-checagem dos impedimentos socioambientais do crédito rural (MCR 2-9).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @apto/regras && npm run build -w @apto/api && npm run build -w @apto/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @apto/regras && npm run dev -w @apto/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @apto/regras && npm run dev -w @apto/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @apto/regras && npm run build -w @apto/regras && npm run test -w @apto/api && npm run test -w @apto/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apto/regras && npm run typecheck -w @apto/api && npm run typecheck -w @apto/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run test -w @apto/e2e
